goal: Maximize monthly outbound clicks from workagedleads.com to agedleadstore.com

baseline.note: Prior figure excludes a 73-session spike on 2026-07-07; including it the prior rate is 16.5/day. Post-cutover decline is real and independently reproduces the 5.6/day figure in the email plan.

milestone.rationale: Recover to the pre-cutover rate. First milestone, not the ceiling.

iterations.notes: Per-page affiliate attribution added to /api/reports/outbound-clicks (affiliate.byPage30d, clickRate, leakage). Ledger created. scripts/price-index-gap.ts generates the Q3 study brief. Newsletter restart was found already complete and running — the 2026-08-10 issue sent 2026-08-12 as broadcast a830c99a.

expected.basis: No prior estimate possible — the page had zero affiliate links, so its C was structurally 0 and any traffic it earned converted at 0. This is a wiring fix, not a demand bet. First real expected-value scores start at iteration 2, once affiliate.byPage30d has data.

iterations.notes: Site's most-cited asset (CiteThisButton, Dataset JSON-LD, CC-licensed) had no route to a purchase — every outbound link was internal. Added InlineTextCta after the pricing tables and a compact CtaBanner after the economics section. Two placements not three: a reference page that reads as a sales pitch stops being cited. UTM content values after-pricing / after-economics distinguish the placements. Verified in built HTML; destination returns 200 with a browser UA (bot-blocked for curl default). Page's lastUpdated is still 2026-04-08 — that is the Q3 study's job, not this one.

iterations.targetCluster: commercial lead-type queries (aged mortgage leads, aged insurance leads, final expense leads, iul leads)

expected.basis: 629 views/mo across the top four lead-type pages converting at ~0.95% today. Modelling C at 5% — 8x below the provider page's measured 43.33% — gives ~31 clicks vs 6, i.e. +25/mo on a 69-click base. A hypothesis to test, not a forecast: intent on a guide page is genuinely lower than on a provider review, and the gap will not fully close.

iterations.notes: Both hero buttons on these pages were internal (/compare, /price-index), so the site's highest-traffic commercial pages had no affiliate path above the fold. The mid-page CtaBanner also passes buttonHref, which sets useAffiliate=false — it is an internal compare link sitting exactly where intent peaks. Added a deep-linked door as the primary hero action; compare and pricing keep their position as secondary. Deep links verified per page: mortgage-leads -> /mortgage-leads-purchase-refinance/, final-expense-leads -> /life-insurance-leads/. insurance-leads correctly falls back to /all-lead-types/ — the partner has no generic-insurance buy page and that mapping is deliberate (lib/affiliate.ts, confirmed by Bill 2026-08-06). Destinations re-verified: 200, zero redirects, real buy pages ('Aged Mortgage Leads', 'Buy Aged Life Insurance Leads for Agents — From $0.25'). rel=nofollow sponsored and disclosure present on every instance. Measure via utm_content=hero-door.

scoreboardReadings.note: First reading from the per-page attribution built in iteration 0. Affiliate daily average of 2.30 is BELOW the 3/day flag threshold in CLICK-LOOP.md — but this counts GA4 outbound click events, while the 5.4/day baseline counts sessions arriving at agedleadstore.com. Different denominators; do not read one as a decline against the other. Trend this series against itself going forward.

nextPick.candidate: Above-the-fold, deep-linked affiliate door on /lead-types/[slug] and /lead-types
nextPick.rationale: The scoreboard separates D from C cleanly. /providers/aged-lead-store converts at 43.33% on 90 views and supplies 39 of 69 affiliate clicks. The four biggest lead-type pages carry 629 views but convert at ~0.95%. They are not short of CTAs — they already render three (two CtaBanner, one InlineTextCta) versus the provider page's one. What the provider page has and they lack is a prominent outbound door above the fold ('Visit Website' hero, providers/[slug]/page.tsx:297). Intent is also higher there, so the gap will not fully close.

expected.basis: 629 views/mo on the top four lead-type pages. Modelling C at 5% — still 8x below the provider page's measured 43% — yields ~31 clicks vs 6 today, i.e. +25/mo against a 69-click base (+36%). Deliberately conservative; treat 5% as the hypothesis to test, not a forecast.

alsoConsidered: Leakage recapture: 61 of 130 outbound clicks (47%) go to the 14 non-monetized hosts, mostly via the same 'Visit Website' hero on competitor profile pages. NOT a candidate for removal — those links are what make the reviews independent, and pruning link-out endpoints is explicitly off-limits. The defensible version is offering the ALS alternative alongside, where the benchmark data supports it.

Price-index pages convert well (life-insurance 8.33%, medicare 12.50%, auto-insurance 10.00%) on almost no traffic (8-24 views). High C, no D. Fixing that is a traffic problem, which is what the Q3 study and its nine trend charts address.
Comparison pages draw ~2 views each despite being indexed. Not worth investment until they earn impressions.
